notes: The person's citation (Isa.30.17) doesn't contain this root at all -- that verse's verb is H5127 (נוס, "flee"). The only actual attestation of H5264 is Zech.9.16 (מִתְנוֹסְסוֹת, "[the stones of a crown] lifted up as an ensign"), which matches the gloss "display" and the lexicon's "raise a beacon; lift up as an ensign" -- shipped with the corrected citation. True homograph with H5263 ("be sick"), same spelling נסס -- this root is נסס² (H5263 is נסס¹) per the root-key superscript convention.
